- **`time.clock`** (medium confidence): Dyula 'lɛrɛ {h}' (lɛrɛ = hour, from French, the everyday Dyula word and already used by this locale), additive 'lɛrɛ {h} ni miniti N' and 'lɛrɛ {h} ni tilancɛ'.
